title: Component passes inside a parent memory grant: what the grant carries, what it never can, and how a larger need reaches it

ceilingMegabytes.description: What this machine could ever give the grant: its memory less the floor of the capacity gate.

growth.description: none: no growth path; exact: an exact grant whose holder never grows it and no supplementary reservation; acquire-*: a supplementary reservation of the difference is asked, granted or refused by the gate (exact-acquire-granted: the grant is exact as well).
